purpose: Evaluate whether present-day spatial gradients, repeated trait history, relative event placement and ecological correspondence converge on the same candidate selective-pressure domain for each capitulum component.

core_distinction.azami: present-day phenotype sorting along environmental gradients across space
core_distinction.eazami_current_ecology: present-day state-associated niche differences within the East-Asian comparison
core_distinction.eazami_historical_environment: environmental change or variability associated with dated transition windows; not yet identifiable without an admitted dated event map

evidence_dimensions.label: repeated_history
evidence_dimensions.question: How many changes are minimally required across the accepted topology ensemble?

evidence_dimensions.label: event_placement
evidence_dimensions.question: Are minimum histories relatively deep, shallow or broadly unresolved?
evidence_dimensions.boundary: Relative lineage-depth is topology-only and is not calendar time.

evidence_dimensions.label: spatial_gradient
evidence_dimensions.question: Which present-day environmental gradient is associated with the homologous phenotype in Azami?

evidence_dimensions.label: current_ecological_correspondence
evidence_dimensions.question: Do present trait states occupy different present-day niches after phylogenetic correction?
evidence_dimensions.boundary: Current niche centroids are not ancestral environments.

evidence_dimensions.label: historical_environmental_correspondence
evidence_dimensions.question: Do dated transition windows align with independently specified environmental changes or high-variability intervals?

evidence_dimensions.label: function_and_fitness
evidence_dimensions.question: Does manipulating the trait alter the nominated mechanism and reproductive fitness?

interpretation_classes.spatial_adaptive_pattern_candidate: S is supported under Azami controls; no historical or functional promotion follows.
interpretation_classes.space_time_selection_pressure_candidate: R is supported and S plus C converge on a common ecological domain, while P and F remain unresolved.
interpretation_classes.historical_environment_candidate: A space-time selection-pressure candidate whose dated transition windows also show prespecified P correspondence against an admissible null.
interpretation_classes.adaptive_explanation: Historical-environment correspondence is joined to a replicated trait-to-mechanism-to-fitness path; no current public-data trait reaches this class.
interpretation_classes.unidentified: Comparison is blocked by missing homologous trait ontology, inadequate overlap or missing dated environmental linkage; it is not discordance.

concordance_rule.no_cross_trait_composite_p_value: Only two Azami traits pass the robust among-taxon candidate gate and temporal estimands differ among traits.

absolute_time_gate.reason: The active Japan38 history scaffold has substitutions-per-site branch lengths and the admitted relative lineage-depth coordinate does not supply calendar ages.
absolute_time_gate.required_input: An accession- or node-audited dated chronogram that can carry the Japan38 trait states across topology uncertainty.
absolute_time_gate.prohibited_shortcut: Do not linearly convert relative lineage-depth to Ma or scale all events from a single published radiation age.

required_before_testing: dated transition windows propagated across the accepted topology ensemble
prespecified public paleoclimate or connectivity series with temporal uncertainty
factor-specific hypotheses fixed before event overlap is inspected
a null conditional on branch duration, topology and trait coverage

factor_difference_explanations: environmental mean versus seasonality or variability
present niche occupancy versus historical environmental exposure
non-homologous image proxy versus authority-coded botanical state
climate proxy versus unmeasured biotic interaction turnover
trait-specific evolutionary depth and localization uncertainty
claim_boundary: Convergence of R, S and C strengthens a candidate selective-pressure explanation but does not establish event-specific historical causation, adaptation, independent origins, convergence or fitness benefit.
